entities.summary: Vece Paes was an Indian field hockey player. He was a midfielder. He was also a sports physician and sports administrator. Paes was part of the Indian hockey team that won the bronze medal at the 1972 Munich Olympics. He was a sports medicine expert and held positions in various sports bodies, including the BCCI and ACC.
